name: postemi
description: Write, preview, schedule and publish social media posts with Postemi in ChatGPT. Manage your content calendar and check channel and post analytics across supported accounts.

interface.longDescription:
Postemi is a social media scheduler. Connect it and you can post to every major social network from one chat with ChatGPT: Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, Pinterest and 28 more platforms and apps, including Discord, Telegram, Slack, Mastodon, WordPress and newsletters such as Mailchimp and Kit.

What you can do:
- Post everywhere at once. Ask ChatGPT to write a post, pick your channels, and publish it now, schedule it for later or save it as a draft.
- Plan a week or a month of content in one conversation. Then ask "what's scheduled next week?" and edit, move or delete posts as plans change, or retry one that failed.
- Keep every network's format right. Each channel can get its own text, with threads on X, Threads and Bluesky, first comments on LinkedIn and Facebook, and options such as an Instagram reel or story, a Pinterest board or a YouTube title.
- Add your photos and videos in full quality, from a link or from your computer or phone (videos up to 1 GB).
- See what worked. Ask how a channel did over the last 90 days or how one post performed, and get the platform's own numbers: reach, impressions, followers, likes, views.
- Run several brands or clients, each in its own workspace.

You stay in control. Before anything is saved, you see a preview: the account and @handle, the publish time in your own timezone, and character counts against each network's real limit. Nothing is posted until you confirm.

Getting started: sign in to Postemi in your browser, no API key needed. Connecting AI assistants is part of the Pro, Creator and Team plans, and every plan starts with a 7-day free trial. No plan yet? Pick one on the sign-in screen and come straight back to ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Preview an Instagram and Facebook post about our weekend offer for Friday at 9:00.
How did my Instagram channel do over the past seven days?

positive.description: Start in the Team review workspace with a saved timezone and connected Facebook Page, Instagram and YouTube test channels. Import the public Postemi test image and preview the same feed post on Facebook and Instagram for one week from today.
positive.prompt: Use https://raw.githubusercontent.com/norbertlevente/postemi-agent/3f9ab6abcc6398124512c0d9cc18a3d55412dbad/listing/logo/postemi-square-black-1024.png as the image for a post that says “Postemi review test post.” Preview it on my Facebook Page and Instagram feed one week from today at 10:00 in my Postemi timezone. Wait for my approval before scheduling.
positive.expected_behavior: Imports the public PNG and attaches the returned media path to both preview entries. Uses the two channel IDs and settings from the tool results and the same ISO 8601 UTC date with type=schedule for both entries. Shows the image, text, account names and handles where available, local publish time, character counts and per-account limits. No post is created.

positive.description: Continue the same conversation after the Facebook and Instagram previews have no blocking problems. Approve both scheduled posts and complete any confirmation shown by ChatGPT.
positive.prompt: I confirm. Schedule both posts exactly as previewed.
positive.expected_behavior: After confirmation, uses the two previewed entries, including date, settings and media path, with type=schedule and a fresh idempotency key. Uses the two returned post IDs to verify both are in QUEUE for the previewed time in list_posts. The reply reports both channels and the scheduled local time.

positive.description: Reuse the imported image and scheduled time from the previous cases. Preview the same image-only post on the connected YouTube test channel.
positive.prompt: Show me whether that same image post would work on YouTube at the same time. Use the title “Postemi review test” and unlisted visibility. Only preview it.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews the YouTube channel ID with the PNG attachment, previous UTC time, title=Postemi review test and visibility type=unlisted. Surfaces the video requirement from the preview problems and explains that a video is needed. No create_post call occurs.

positive.description: Use the same connected Instagram test channel. The review workspace has a sample Instagram post published through Postemi in the last 30 days.
positive.prompt: How did my Instagram channel and its latest published post perform over the past seven days?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_analytics with the Instagram integrationId and days=7. Uses list_posts with that channel, state=PUBLISHED and an explicit past 30-day UTC range. Calls get_post_analytics with the latest published postId and days=7. Identifies the channel and post and reports the returned metrics for each, or relays the tool's explanation if data is unavailable. No missing metric is reported as zero.

positive.description: Use the two IDs returned by the scheduling case. Review the calendar result, then confirm deletion of those two test posts only.
positive.prompt: Show me the two Postemi review test posts we scheduled, including their UTC and local times. Then cancel those two posts.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the two matching IDs in state QUEUE with their channels and UTC and local publish times. After confirmation, deletes each specific ID with allChannels omitted or false. The reply identifies the removed posts and a second list_posts call for the same window confirms that neither ID remains.

negative.description: A request about appointments belongs to the user's meeting calendar. Answer with an appropriate calendar source or explain that access is needed. No Postemi tools should be called.
negative.prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?

negative.description: A private email is outside social scheduling. Draft the email in chat without creating a social post or invoking any Postemi tools.
negative.prompt: Write a short email to my landlord about the broken heater in my flat.

negative.description: General knowledge about a social network needs no data from the user's channels. Answer the question without calling Postemi or requesting account access.
negative.prompt: In general, how does Instagram decide which reels to show people?

prompts: Preview a photo post for my Facebook Page and Instagram feed next Friday at 9:00.
What posts are scheduled for next week? Show the times in my timezone.
How did my Instagram channel and its latest published post perform over the past seven days?

publication.release_notes: Initial release of Postemi for ChatGPT. Connect your Postemi workspace to preview posts for each account, schedule or publish across 37 platforms and apps, and manage upcoming posts in a content calendar. Attach images and videos, review channel and published-post analytics, and open the calendar, composer and channels from ChatGPT.
